_about: Candidate funding leads copied from lanes/3-fund-it/data/DATA-SOURCES.md (checked Nov 6, 2026 by the event organizers). NestFlix did NOT re-fetch these pages. No award amounts, deadlines or open/closed claims are stated unless the source file stated them. Every program is a lead, not approved or available funding.

programs.name: CalHome Program
programs.description: State homeownership program: loans to local agencies and nonprofits for down payment, rehab and self-help activities.
programs.eligibility_notes: Page describes loans to local agencies and nonprofits. Income caps tie to HCD State Income Limits (revised June 23, 2026 memo). Detailed eligibility was not read.
programs.restrictions: Funds are often loans, not grants: do not treat as an unconditional grant. Round dates and compliance terms not read.

programs.name: Homeownership Super NOFA (HOSN)
programs.description: Current state notice of funding availability that bundles homeownership programs.
programs.eligibility_notes: Which bundled programs apply to this project was not read. Check the NOFA text.
programs.restrictions: Periodic or competitive. Round dates and compliance terms not read.

programs.name: HOME Investment Partnerships (via State HCD)
programs.description: Federal HOME funds administered through the state. Buyer income caps tie to the State HOME income limits table (effective June 1, 2026).
programs.eligibility_notes: Use the State HOME income limits PDF, not the general State income limits. Rules at https://www.hudexchange.info/programs/home/.
programs.restrictions: Federal compliance requirements apply; details not read.

programs.name: Community Development Block Grant (State CDBG)
programs.eligibility_notes: Whether an Orange County project is eligible under the State program (versus city entitlement CDBG) was not read.

programs.name: CDBG Entitlement (city-level)
programs.description: City-level CDBG. Which Orange County city programs fund homeownership development was not confirmed.
programs.eligibility_notes: Depends on the city where the project sits. Project city is unknown in this synthetic deal.

programs.name: Self-Help Homeownership Opportunity Program (SHOP)
programs.category: Land and infrastructure funds for sweat-equity builders
programs.description: Funds land and infrastructure for sweat-equity and volunteer-based homeownership builders rather than whole-home costs.
programs.verification_status: VERIFIED (page mentions sweat equity and volunteer-based programs)
programs.eligibility_notes: Applies only if the project uses sweat-equity or volunteer labor. The synthetic deal does not say it does.
programs.restrictions: Limits what a dollar can pay for (land and infrastructure, not whole-home costs).

programs.name: Affordable Housing Program (AHP)
programs.category: FHLBank competitive grants and subsidized advances
programs.eligibility_notes: Round dates and terms not read.
programs.restrictions: Competitive; periodic rounds. Terms not read.

programs.name: Orange County Housing Finance Trust
programs.description: Countywide housing funding. The programs page loads and shows a NOFA; the home page has no homeownership text.
programs.eligibility_notes: Whether the NOFA covers ownership homes was not confirmed.

programs.name: Low Income Investment Fund (CDFI lender)
programs.description: CDFI lender for affordable housing. A source of capital, repayable.
programs.restrictions: Repayable debt: never counted as an unconditional grant.

programs.name: Low-Income Housing Tax Credit (LIHTC)
programs.description: Per DATA-SOURCES.md: rental only, not applicable to ownership. Kept here so the matcher can show an exclusion.

programs.name: CalHFA MyHome Assistance
programs.description: Junior loan for homebuyers. The page says up to 3.5% (FHA) or 3% (conventional). Repayable.
programs.eligibility_notes: Buyer income, credit and loan-type rules were not read.
programs.restrictions: Buyer-side loan: do not also count it as developer subsidy.
programs.maximum_funding_if_verified: Page states up to 3.5% (FHA) or 3% (conventional). Read the page for the base amount.

programs.name: CalHFA Dream For All
programs.description: Shared appreciation loan. Page says up to 20%, not to exceed $150,000, with voucher registration and a randomized drawing.
programs.verification_status: VERIFIED (page loads); availability of funds NOT confirmed
programs.availability_status: Availability not confirmed. Unread search results suggest it ran out of money in 2023.
programs.eligibility_notes: Voucher registration and a randomized drawing: no approval can be assumed.
programs.restrictions: Shared appreciation (repayable). Buyer-side: do not also count as developer subsidy.
programs.maximum_funding_if_verified: Page states up to 20%, not to exceed $150,000.

programs.name: FHLBank SF WISH
programs.description: Grants for first-time buyer down-payment help via member banks.
programs.eligibility_notes: Goes through a member bank. First-time buyer status and income rules not read.
programs.restrictions: Buyer-side: do not also count as developer subsidy.

programs.description: City down-payment loan. The page loads; loan terms in DATA-SOURCES.md came from a search snippet, so read the page.
programs.eligibility_notes: Applies to homes in Santa Ana. Household eligibility not read.

programs.eligibility_notes: Applies to homes in Garden Grove. Dollar tiers came from a snippet only.
